svg.title: The collapse of Assyrian power
svg.desc: The collapse of Assyrian power. Geographic orientation map with land, water, coastlines, rivers, and these places: Nineveh, known location; Harran, known location; Carchemish, known location; Babylon, known location. The map locates the major cities involved in Assyria's decline. Exact military routes and borders are not shown.

text.tspan: The map locates the major cities involved in Assyria's decline. Exact military routes and borders are not
Modern coastlines and rivers are shown for orientation; no unrecorded route or ancient border is claimed.
